player_prompt.intro:
A si Maaɓe {player_id} ({role}) e ɗemngal Matching Pennies ɓurɓe {num_rounds}.
- E ɗemngal kadi, kadi [heads] ko [tails] (ko [h], [t]).
- So kaŋkoŋo maa maaɓe ɓe, Maaɓe 0 ɗon ɗemngal; ɓeɗen, Maaɓe 1 ɗon.
Wali kaŋkoŋo maa maa '[heads]' ko '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Maaɓe 0 ɓe {choice0}; Maaɓe 1 ɓe {choice1}. Match -> Maaɓe 0 ɗon
message.round_mismatch: Maaɓe 0 ɓe {choice0}; Maaɓe 1 ɓe {choice1}. Mismatch -> Maaɓe 1 ɗon.

outcome.p1_wins: Kambiwu 1ye dǝ kǝla awowa gade lan kozǝna.
outcome.draw: Futu faraskәna dәye shima awo laa.
